card.name: Gaps between numbers in tables
card.fires_on: A space or separator right after a number or unit, where another number or column entry comes next, as in dose tables, lab-grade tables and dated web posts. Also the closing bracket after a section number such as (2.2.

modes.label: Space between table values
modes.description: A blank space between numeric entries in a dosing or rate table, just before the next value.

modes.label: Space after a date or statistic
modes.description: A space after a date, time or count in web text, before the following text.

modes.label: Section number bracket
modes.description: A closing parenthesis after a subsection number like 2.2 in prescribing information headings.
modes.example: intervals should be at least 15 minutes. (2.2<<)>> Administration Epoprostenol for injection
